translations.web: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”
translations.bsb: “Into what, then, were you baptized?” Paul asked. “The baptism of John,” they replied.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
